verdicts.reason: Both break up the badge row: FREE ENTRY is stranded under the date block while ALL AGES and TASTINGS sit above the CTA. Both also jam the date, badges and RSVP button into a cramped lower band, and the centred headline column is off-centre on the canvas. In A, the URL line runs right into the partner-mark placeholder, and the address wraps badly ('Harbour / Rooftop, Pier 9'). B wraps the address more cleanly and keeps the URL clear of the placeholder, but its headline column is shifted even further left of centre.
